_doc: Admin-panel editable (committed from /admin via the GitHub API). Every change rebuilds Cloudflare Pages automatically. scripts/build.mjs regenerates src/providers/generated-data.js from this file; src/providers/registry.js instantiates every enabled provider from it. API KEYS ARE NEVER STORED HERE — they are Cloudflare env secrets (see /env-setup).
